title: Mushroom and Poblano Quesadillas with Oregano and Queso Fresco
summary: Mushrooms are steamed in a little water then browned with poblano and onion, mixed with mozzarella, queso fresco and coriander, and folded into tortillas cooked until crisp.
equipment: large non-stick frying pan (at least 26 cm)
wire rack set on a baking tray

ingredients.item: poblano or green pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the mushrooms
steps.text: Put the mushrooms and 3 tbsp water in the pan over medium-high heat, cover and cook for 4 minutes until collapsed. Uncover and cook 4-5 minutes until the liquid has gone.

steps.title: Brown the vegetables
steps.text: Add the oil, pepper and onion and cook for 6-7 minutes, stirring, until browned and soft. Stir in the garlic, oregano and salt for 1 minute. Tip into the bowl, cool 5 minutes and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Stir the mozzarella, queso fresco and coriander into the vegetables.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread a quarter of the filling over one half of each tortilla, leaving a 1 cm border, and fold over, pressing gently.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Put the rack on its tray in a 100 °C (80 °C fan) oven. Heat 1 tbsp oil in the pan over medium heat and cook 2 quesadillas 2-3 minutes per side until crisp and golden and the cheese has melted. Keep warm and repeat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve with lime.

tips: Starting the mushrooms in water drives out their moisture fast so they brown instead of stewing.
Cool the filling slightly so the cheese doesn't melt before the tortillas crisp.
A green pepper works if you can't find poblano; add a pinch of chilli flakes for heat.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour and eat within 3 days. Reheat in a dry pan until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
